_meta.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API — ECMWF ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis (model 'era5_seamless')
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
_meta.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0); Hersbach et al. (2020) ERA5, Copernicus C3S
_meta.method: One request per city, daily values in local time. Per calendar month over the window: mean daily max/min 2 m temperature; mean of daily-mean relative humidity; mean count of days with precipitation >= 1.0 mm; mean monthly precipitation total. Months with <25 valid days are excluded from the wet-day / total averages.
_meta.caveat: Reanalysis grid-cell values, not station normals. ERA5 is ~0.25° (~25-30 km), ERA5-Land ~0.1° (~9 km). Open-Meteo lapse-rate-downscales temperature from the model cell height (grid.modelCellElevation) to a 90 m DEM height at the point (grid.elevation), but it cannot fix land/sea mixing in coastal cells, valley inversions or urban heat islands. ERA5 tends to over-count light-rain days in the tropics and smooth convective extremes.
